INSERT INTO campaigns (campaign_id, status) VALUES ('{{$json.campaignId}}'::uuid, 'running') RETURNING campaign_id;

SELECT
  c.campaign_id,
  TO_CHAR(c.created_at, 'Mon DD, HH12:MI AM') AS created,
  COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total,
  COUNT(l.lead_id) FILTER(WHERE l.outreach_sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS sent,
  COUNT(l.lead_id) FILTER(WHERE l.reply_sentiment = 'positive') AS interested,
  COUNT(l.lead_id) FILTER(WHERE l.demo_sent_at IS NOT NULL OR l.demo_url IS NOT NULL) AS demos
FROM campaigns c
LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.created_at
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE outreach_sent_at  >= NOW() - ('{{ $json.extra }}'::interval)) AS sent,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE reply_detected_at >= NOW() - ('{{ $json.extra }}'::interval) AND reply_sentiment = 'positive') AS interested,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'replied_negative'::lead_status AND updated_at >= NOW() - ('{{ $json.extra }}'::interval)) AS negative,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE demo_sent_at      >= NOW() - ('{{ $json.extra }}'::interval)) AS demos
FROM leads;
SELECT lead_id, company_name, city FROM leads WHERE status = 'replied_positive'::lead_status AND demo_url IS NULL ORDER BY reply_detected_at DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT lead_id, company_name, email, city, demo_url, demo_sent_at
FROM leads
WHERE demo_sent_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY demo_sent_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads) AS total_leads,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'new'::lead_status) AS new_leads,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE outreach_sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS emails_sent,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE reply_sentiment = 'positive') AS interested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE reply_sentiment = 'negative') AS not_interested,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE demo_sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS demos_sent,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE status = 'dead'::lead_status) AS dead,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaigns) AS total_campaigns;
